description: Inactive / active registration by county x party group for GG22 and PG24, and their mean.

sources.inactive: turnout_counts: family 'eligible-inactive', geography 'county', category 'ALL', measure inactive; GG22 as_of 2022-10-22, PG24 as_of 2024-10-20
sources.active: turnout_counts: family 'eligible-active', geography 'county', category 'ALL', measure active; GG22 as_of 2022-10-22, PG24 as_of 2024-10-20

checks_passed: GG22 inactive party rows sum to the ALL row per county
GG22 active party rows sum to the ALL row per county
GG22 eligible-active statewide equals official-turnout eligible
PG24 inactive party rows sum to the ALL row per county
PG24 active party rows sum to the ALL row per county
PG24 eligible-active statewide equals official-turnout eligible
24 counties x 3 party groups, no missing values
notes: inactive_ratio_mean is the unweighted mean of the GG22 and PG24 ratios.
